name: Jeremiah
overview: Jeremiah was a male prophet from the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the son of Hilkiah and hailing from Anathoth. Known primarily as a prophet, he played a significant role in delivering God's messages during a tumultuous period in Judah's history.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremiah means 'y-h-v-h loosens [the womb]; y-h-v-h lifts up; [poss.] y-h-v-h shoots, establishes,' reflecting aspects of God's action or character. This proper name was not given by God but carries deep theological significance related to God's involvement in life and restoration.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jeremiah as the son of Hilkiah. It is also inferred from the text that Shallum was related to him either as a nephew or cousin, indicating some extended family connections within his community.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremiah is a pivotal prophetic figure who faithfully communicated God's warnings and promises to Judah for over forty years despite facing opposition and suffering. He witnessed the destruction of Jerusalem and prophesied the coming New Covenant, which points forward to Christ and the gospel. His ministry exemplifies steadfast faithfulness amid rejection and highlights God's plan for restoration after exile.
